column1: # The index examples/typst-unprinted.qmd prints in a Typst render (M117, M118).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# tests/typst-index-main.tsv states. Page 1 holds the title, the table of
# contents and the text up to the source's one page break, and page 2 follows
# it. Quarto's Typst template does not print `description:`, so no mark
# written there adds a locator or makes a cross-reference print.
#   Bitt     in the description and on page 2: page 2 alone
#   Block    page 2, its one see to Sheave, which the description alone marks:
#   Boom     the description alone, as is Vang under it, whose see is written
#   Cleat    page 1; its sub-entry Horn is in the description alone: no row
#   Clew     page 2, a see to Sheave and then one to Paddle: Paddle alone
#   Davit    the description alone, above Arm on page 2: no locator
#   Fender   the description alone, as is Rope under it, above Eye on page 2
#   Gaff     the description alone, above Jaw, which has a see and no page
#   Halyard  the description alone, as is Hawser: neither row, no H group
#   Jib      page 2, its one see to Block, left out above: no row, no J group
#   Kedge    page 2, a see and no page
#   Keel     page 2, a see to Rudder, which no mark files: kept, and reported
#   Mast     no mark of its own, above Step, a range like Rig's: no locators
#   Oar      a see mark in the description alone: no row, no O group
#   Paddle   page 1, and a see-also mark in the description alone: no
#   Rig      a range opened in the description, closed on page 2: no locator
#   Tack     page 2, a see to Yawl, which sees Tack from page 2: kept
#   Thwart   a see to Paddle in the description and on page 2: kept
#   Winch    a see-also mark in the description alone: no row, no W group
#   Yawl     page 2, a see to Tack: kept
# Thole and Pin, the second index's marks, are not in this one.
